description: Makes a one-use link that connects a social account to this Xyla shop, or reconnects a broken one. Give the merchant the link to open in their browser; it works once and expires in 10 minutes, and asks for the store's email. To reconnect an account from connection_status, pass its social_media_account_id. Instagram has two ways in: instagram_direct (Instagram Login, the usual choice) and instagram (through a Facebook Page, needed for Stories and product tags). Disconnecting stays on the Xyla website.

social_media_account_id.description: The account to reconnect, from connection_status. Leave out to connect a new account.

name: connect_account
title: Connect a social account
